verdict.rationale: The evidence documents bank reconciliation, auto-generated reconciliation reports, discrepancy reports and generic custom workflows. Nothing describes a month-end close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals and review sign-offs. Standalone reconciliation and generic workflows are adjacent features, not the close-checklist capability itself.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
